links.comparator_used: Monitoring discrimination (AUC) alone across chronological BRFSS cycles and external NHANES reference
links.outcome: Detection of drift and performance change not visible from discrimination alone
links.effect: AUC declined only modestly from 0.8638 in 2016 to 0.8495 in 2024, yet calibration and predictor-level changes were detected. Frozen unrecalibrated model in pooled NHANES: AUC = 0.8681, Brier Score = 0.1131.
links.quote: Aggregate discrimination alone did not capture calibration and predictor-level changes.
